analysis:
## 1. Overall Health Assessment

The repository shows concerning stagnation with 47% of open issues being stale for 30+ days, and critical production bugs dating back 147 days. While the team addresses new bugs effectively, the high volume of unresolved legacy issues and showstopper bugs poses significant operational risk.

## 2. Top 3 Risks

1. **Critical Production Bugs**: Issues like #5414 (147 days old) affecting case submission and #5740 (58 days old) impacting case rescheduling remain unresolved, directly impacting court operations
2. **Stale Issue Backlog**: 93 stale issues (47% of open) indicate poor issue lifecycle management and potential knowledge loss
3. **Resource Imbalance**: Top assignee has 54 issues while 10 others have <30 each, creating single points of failure and knowledge silos

## 3. Actionable Recommendations

• **Immediate Triage**: Assign 2 engineers to resolve the top 5 oldest showstopper bugs within 2 weeks, prioritizing #5414 and #5740
• **Stale Issue Cleanup**: Implement automated stale bot with 60-day close policy and manually review/close 50+ stale issues this sprint
• **Load Balancing**: Redistribute assignee workload - cap individual assignments at 25 issues and cross-train team members on critical components
• **Process Fix**: Establish weekly issue grooming sessions to prevent future stale accumulation and ensure proper labeling/status updates

## 4. Positive Signals

Strong velocity on new bug fixes (issues #5888-#5880 are 0-17 days old and actively addressed), good distribution of work across 10+ team members, and consistent delivery of QA-complete features ready for UAT release indicate solid engineering execution capabilities.
